body: I have a problem with these scripts. I installed ART in: _C:\Program Files\ART_ **NOT using** the version number subdir (ie 1.26.1 or whatever). In these conditions when I try to launch the "**AI masking (SMART)**" user command, then it reports that _it cannot find ART_: I suspect this is because the script doesn't take into account the possibility of this kind of installation. Script thinks that ART could be installed only in: C:\Program Files\ART\n.nn.n\ where **n.nn.n** is whichever version number of ART. Beside, I did not arrived to test the part of the script which manages **smart.exe** execution, but I suspect that also in this case SMART prg location is limited to: **... %APPDATALOCAL%\SMART-0.2-win64-portable*\* directory. If I want to set the content of the package to a dir named for example: **... %APPDATALOCAL%\SMART\** then the script doesn't recognize this as a valid path for finding and running smart.exe. If this is the case it should be specified in a note. Anyway, regarding to the ART location, the possibility of its installation in: C:\Program Files\ART should be taken into account by the script. Am I correct or did I miss something? Regards, Topoldo
